title: Music Library
subtitle: Manage your song library across all stations.
search_placeholder: Search by title, artist, or album...
empty_library: No songs yet. Upload your first song to get started.
delete_message: This will permanently delete the song and remove it from all stations. The audio file will also be removed.
drop_files: Drop audio files here, or click to browse
many_files_hint: You can add any number of files at once — each audio file becomes its own track. Supported formats: MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, AAC, M4A, WMA, OPUS.
drop_zip: Drop a ZIP archive here or click to browse
zip_section_hint: All audio files inside the archive will be added as separate tracks.
no_stations: No stations created yet. Songs will be uploaded without station assignment.
